data.title: Crypto Weekly Digest | Bitcoin Surges 23% to $77.6K; Record $2.7B Short Squeeze; US Regulation Breakthrough Expected
data.description: Market Summary $Bitcoin (BTC.CC)$ surged 20.63% over the past 7 days to $77,446, trading between $70,000 and $79,000 during the week.
